claims.text: The extension ships an authority-surface spec section, with guidance on completing it, that a project fills in per spec - principals and their channels, authorized actions, authorized destinations, and standing prohibitions; an action, destination, or channel not listed is not authorized, and the assess command treats a missing or uncompleted section as a gap for a system that acts on read content.

evidence.description: Requirement stated in Spec 007 MS-01, which this claim commits to test.

The shipped template carries the five required parts (principals and channels, authorized actions, authorized destinations, standing prohibitions, challenge records) and states that an unlisted action or destination is not authorized and a blank row is a refusal; the assess command treats a missing or placeholder section as a gap to report.

falsification_tests: Open the shipped authority-surface template and observe any of the five required parts missing, or read the assess command and observe no instruction to treat a missing or uncompleted authority surface as a gap.

claims.text: The planted-injection battery runs as an assessment gate over the vendored deterministic screener: exit 0 when the bars are met, 1 when a bar is not met, 2 on error as a clean refusal; the bars are an epistemic-layer challenge rate of at least 95% on injections and zero challenged legitimate controls, with notes reported and never gated.

evidence.description: Requirement stated in Spec 007 MS-02, which this claim commits to test.

Running the vendored screener over the vendored corpus reproduces the design study's recorded results exactly: the epistemic layer challenges 55 of 56 injection fixtures, challenges 0 of 50 legitimate controls, and notes 29 of 50 controls; the single miss is the known self-framing residual fixture.

falsification_tests: Run the battery gate on the vendored corpus and observe the epistemic layer challenge fewer than 95% of injections or any legitimate control, or run it on a corpus built to miss a bar and observe an exit code other than 1.
